messages:
Ori Nakamura: Hey everyone! I'm Ori — starting today on Platform (they/them). Remote in Vancouver but I'll be in SF the week of May 6 if anyone wants to grab coffee. Big fan of astrophotography, frisbee, and weekend baking. Happy to be here!

Casey Liu: Welcome Ori!! :tada: We have a casual frisbee meetup Thu @5 on the rooftop lawn — come join if you're in SF.

Maya Chen: Hi Ori 👋 I brought mismatched socks today, so you're in good company. If you like plants, we do a weekly desk plant swap (very low-pressure).

Juniper Sato: welcome!! if you're in office the week of May 6 ping me — i'll book a coffee slot and intro you to the infra crew ☕️

Ori Nakamura: Thanks all! I'll aim for Thu rooftop — fingers crossed for sun. Quick q: what time is the snack stash restock? 😅

Sam Pizza: Haha around 10:30 usually. Also bagels Friday morning if you want to sign up for bagel duty. We call it the 'bagelroll' :bagel:

Priya Singh: FYI HRBot will DM you an onboarding checklist and calendar invites. Pro tip: set your timezone in Slack prefs so standup times don't surprise you.

HRBot: Hello Ori Nakamura — welcome to Redwood Inference! Onboarding checklist sent. If you'd like hardware setup in SF, please fill out this quick form: https://redwood-internal/onboard-hw

Dana Ortiz: Welcome Ori! Small welcome lunch in the kitchen on Wednesday at 12:30 — bring a favorite snack or sandwich to share if you can (no pressure).

Ori Nakamura: Ooh sandwich potluck sounds perfect. I'll bring challah french toast muffins (they're vegetarian). Looking forward to meeting y'all in person! :sparkles:
